subject: Quantitative Aptitude
topic: Time and Work — Pipes, Efficiency and Combined Work (W9)

questions.stem: A can do a piece of work in 10 days and B can do it in 15 days. How many days will they take together?
questions.explanation: B is correct. Combined rate = 1/10 + 1/15 = 3/30 + 2/30 = 5/30 = 1/6. Together = 6 days. Short Trick: together = (A×B)/(A+B) = (10×15)/(10+15) = 150/25 = 6.

questions.stem: A can complete a job in 20 days. After working for 5 days, what fraction of work remains?
questions.explanation: C is correct. Work done in 5 days = 5/20 = 1/4. Remaining = 1 − 1/4 = 3/4.

questions.stem: 10 men can complete a work in 15 days. How many men are needed to complete the same work in 6 days?
questions.explanation: C is correct. Total man-days = 10×15 = 150. For 6 days: men = 150/6 = 25. Short Trick: men and days are inversely proportional — fewer days means more men.

questions.stem: A and B together can complete a job in 8 days. A alone can do it in 12 days. How many days does B alone take?
A, B and C together finish a work in 4 days. A and B together can do it in 6 days. In how many days can C alone finish the work?
A can finish a job in 15 days, B in 10 days. A starts alone. After 5 days B also joins. In how many total days is the work done?
questions.explanation: C is correct. A works 5 days alone: completes 5/15 = 1/3. Remaining = 2/3. Together rate = 1/15+1/10 = 2/30+3/30 = 5/30 = 1/6. Days to finish remaining = (2/3)÷(1/6) = 4 days. Total = 5+4 = 9 days.

questions.stem: 8 men or 12 women can complete a work in 20 days. How many days will 6 men and 6 women take?
questions.explanation: D is correct. Total work = 8×20 = 160 man-days = 12×20 = 240 woman-days. 1 man = 240/160 = 1.5 women. 6 men + 6 women = 9 women + 6 women = 15 women. Days = 240/15 = 16.

questions.stem: A completes 1/4 of a job in 5 days. He then calls B, and together they finish the remaining 3/4 in 5 days. How long would B take to do the entire job alone?
questions.explanation: B is correct. A's rate = (1/4)/5 = 1/20 per day. Together they do 3/4 in 5 days → combined rate = (3/4)/5 = 3/20 per day. B's rate = 3/20 − 1/20 = 2/20 = 1/10. B alone = 10 days.

questions.stem: A and B together can do a work in 12 days, B and C in 15 days, and C and A in 20 days. In how many days can all three do it together?
A can finish a job in 15 days and B in 10 days. B works alone for 4 days and then quits. In how many more days will A finish the remaining work?
questions.explanation: C is correct. B does 4/10 = 2/5 of the work. Remaining = 1 − 2/5 = 3/5. A's rate = 1/15. Days for A = (3/5)÷(1/15) = (3/5)×15 = 9 days.
